name: elecnix-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by elecnix: gh-monitor, agent-identity, skills-lock-autoinstall, your-attention, and bellwether.

plugins.name: gh-monitor
plugins.description: Monitor GitHub pull requests in Claude Code by wrapping the gh monitor CLI.

plugins.name: agent-identity
plugins.description: Gives every Claude Code session a minted agent handle such as cc-swift-koala-42.

plugins.name: skills-lock-autoinstall
plugins.description: Auto-installs agent skills from an npx skills lock file (skills-lock.json) on session start.

plugins.name: your-attention
plugins.description: One inbox where every coding agent asks you questions as cards, and your answers reach them at once.

plugins.name: bellwether
plugins.description: Start a child coding agent in a new herdr tab and get a new turn in the parent when it reports, goes idle, blocks, stalls or exits.
